security_code.description: Exact requested security code; do not infer a different issuer.
security_code.title: Security Code

company_name_ja.description: Japanese company name stated in the latest supplied filing.
company_name_ja.title: Company Name Ja

company_name_en.description: English company name stated in the supplied filings, or a faithful romanization when no English name is shown.
company_name_en.title: Company Name En

latest_filename.description: Exact authoritative filename of the filing identified as latest.
latest_filename.title: Latest Filename

latest_period_ja.description: Concise Japanese reporting-period label for the latest filing.
latest_period_ja.title: Latest Period Ja

ResearchCapitalAllocationDecision.description: Compact decision-to-outcome record for a material use of capital.

decision_label_ja.description: Short transaction or program label that remains recognizable across later filings.
decision_label_ja.title: Decision Label Ja

capital_destination_ja.description: The business, segment, capability, asset, balance-sheet use, or shareholder destination that received or released capital.
capital_destination_ja.title: Capital Destination Ja

relative_allocation_evidence_ja.description: Concise disclosed evidence that this destination gained, retained, or lost priority relative to other capital uses, or null when the filings do not support a comparative allocation statement.
relative_allocation_evidence_ja.title: Relative Allocation Evidence Ja

amount_or_scale_ja.description: Material amount or scale exactly as disclosed, or null when unavailable.
amount_or_scale_ja.title: Amount Or Scale Ja

decision_ja.description: What management allocated, acquired, sold, returned, or financed.
decision_ja.title: Decision Ja

stated_rationale_ja.description: Management's stated purpose without treating it as an outcome.
stated_rationale_ja.title: Stated Rationale Ja

funding_or_tradeoff_ja.description: Disclosed funding method, balance-sheet effect, alternative use, or trade-off, or null when the filings do not provide one.
funding_or_tradeoff_ja.title: Funding Or Tradeoff Ja

subsequent_outcomes.description: Later disclosed results potentially relevant to this decision. Keep aggregate or unattributed observations explicitly labeled rather than presenting them as decision-level performance.
subsequent_outcomes.title: Subsequent Outcomes

adverse_evidence_ja.description: Concise contrary signals such as persistent losses, impairment, delayed utilization, disposal after weak performance, or financial strain.
adverse_evidence_ja.title: Adverse Evidence Ja

record_maturity.description: Whether the selected filing window contains a mature, partial, too recent, or otherwise unobservable outcome record. This is not a value-creation verdict.

disclosure_limit_ja.description: Material attribution or disclosure limitation, or null when the record is sufficiently specific.
disclosure_limit_ja.title: Disclosure Limit Ja

ResearchCapitalAllocationDecision.title: ResearchCapitalAllocationDecision

ResearchCapitalAllocationOutcome.description: A later disclosed result connected to one capital-allocation decision.

outcome_ja.description: Concise later operating, profit, margin, cash, capacity, utilization, impairment, disposal, financing, or distribution result. Preserve whether the filing itself connects this result to the decision.
outcome_ja.title: Outcome Ja

attribution.description: Use direct for separately disclosed decision-level results, management_linked when management explicitly connects an aggregate result to the decision, aggregate_only when only a wider segment or group result is visible, and unattributed when no connection is stated.

signal.description: Direction of the disclosed outcome itself, without deciding whether the original allocation created value overall.

ResearchCapitalAllocationOutcome.title: ResearchCapitalAllocationOutcome

ResearchFilingMemo.description: Direct, high-recall summary of one selected filing.

pdf_page_count.description: Physical PDF page count from the supplied document metadata.
pdf_page_count.title: Pdf Page Count

items.description: Decision-useful observations from this filing. Core management discussion is retained even when wording is repetitive.
items.title: Items

unavailable_categories.description: Categories absent or unreadable in this PDF. Do not use this field merely because a section appears routine.
unavailable_categories.title: Unavailable Categories

ResearchFilingMemo.title: ResearchFilingMemo

ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor.description: One comparable annual actual and the next original annual forecast.
ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor.title: ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor

ResearchMemoFinancialPoint.description: One actual or original-forecast value in a year-end filing.
ResearchMemoFinancialPoint.title: ResearchMemoFinancialPoint

ResearchMemoItem.description: One dense filing-specific observation used as an attention guide.

pdf_page.description: Physical 1-indexed PDF page containing the observation.
pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

summary_ja.description: Concise, faithful Japanese summary retaining the original figures, periods, qualifiers, causes, actions, and forecast status needed for later analysis. For capital allocation, prioritize the material decision, its stated purpose, funding or trade-off, and any later operating, profit, margin, cash, capacity, impairment, disposal, debt, liquidity, or distribution outcome. Exact quotation is not required.
summary_ja.title: Summary Ja

ResearchMemoItem.title: ResearchMemoItem

description: Compact chronological research map consumed by synthesis.

filings.description: Exactly one chronological research memo for every selected PDF.
filings.title: Filings

capital_allocation_decisions.description: Compact cross-filing decision-to-outcome records for the most material capital deployments in the selected period. These records organize facts for synthesis but do not decide whether value was created. Return an empty list when the selected filings contain no defensible material record.
capital_allocation_decisions.title: Capital Allocation Decisions

title: JapaneseResearchDossier
